main_text.p: tam notis, quam quæ vulgo notissimæ putantur, Gravitas Levitasque. Elementa sic ornantur: duæ dantur singulis qualitates ex quatuor primis: Ignis summè calidus & excellenter siccus: Aër summè humidus & excellenter calidus: Aqua summè frigida & excellenter humida: Terra summè sicca & excellenter frigida. Textus perquam amœnus est & versicolor! Quò exemplo, in quatuor Humoribus, Bile, Sanguine, Pituitâ, Melancholiâ: in quatuor anni tempestatibus, Vere, Æstate, Autumno, Hyeme: in quatuor vitæ ætatibus, Pueritia, Juventute, Ætatis

page.notes: The last word of the page is a catchword-like continuation "Ætatibus" cut across at the line end; the final word reads "Æta-" with the hyphen, continued on the next page. Left-margin strip notes belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Catchword "Ætatis" is not printed as such: the line ends with "Æta-", so the text ends there.
